notes: Print on demand rebuilt for any product: a full-screen designer (click the text in a customer's PDF to make it a field, or start from a blank page; preview shows exactly what prints), tees, caps and promo items with blanks per size, decorated areas and production steps, and team orders in the portal where every person gets a proof to check. Shopify: connect a brand's store and its paid orders come in by themselves; tracking and stock go back only when switched on. Direct mail: postcards and self-mailers with the client's artwork in 3D, the mailing list checked and de-duplicated with a report for every outcome, proofs the client approves in their portal, then print and mail.
